frozen_official_result.eligible_field_interpretation: Methods are policy-eligible candidates, not selected or scientifically complete; native_complete=false prevents all selection.

limitations: Twelve selected development prompts with two repeats, not fresh held-out confirmation; answers and B/C presentations are not independent task samples.
Four format failures cause missing C outcomes and block the predeclared complete three-method decision. No retry, repair, replacement or retroactive acceptance is applied.
Missing C is concentrated in three tasks, so a complete-case C aggregate would change the task mix. None is produced.
Judge outputs are saved score/group JSON only. Thinking token counts are metadata; no hidden judge thinking text or explanation was retained.
Generation procedures have unequal inference costs; the descriptive planning gain is not compute-controlled attribution.
No human-alignment conclusion, recursive-adaptation result, broad model superiority or generalized creativity claim follows.

next_defect_decision.comparison_policy: Decide a separately declared prospective control/continuation design before new observations. The existing all72 selection policy cannot silently become an A/B-only or complete-case C selector.
